axes.prdBusinessId: PRD R4 P20/A11, §6.6 and §11; native management triage and truthful reply, not completed export/erasure.
axes.identity: Common signed-session authentication, active bound member; body cannot choose actor; conflicting x-principal-id denied before queue access.
axes.roleCapability: Current environment-bound privacy.request.manage, rechecked and share-locked inside the transaction. Legacy support/review_lead role alone cannot authorize these native routes.
axes.objectRow: Queue is intentionally an authorized operator's cross-member view; direct consumer reads remain owner-scoped. Reply targets existing UUID, current version and mutable request state.
axes.fieldProjection: Explicit request fields, user-submitted message, status, reply, deadline and bounded execution metadata. No export payload, archive token, session credential or provider response. No local persistent PII copy.
axes.actionState: Reply only reviewing/responded; completed/rejected/canceled immutable. Approved/executing cannot be overwritten. Invalid transition reproduced as HTTP500 before repair; now explicit409. Failed can return to reviewing only.
axes.environment: Authority grant environment must match AppConfig; test identities and destructive tests only in newly owned disposable DB/S3. No real production grant or data operation executed.
axes.inputBoundary: UUID, nonempty trimmed <=4000-codepoint reply, integer positive expectedVersion, bounded status enum; server body and request budgets inherited. Extra fields do not select identity or execution.
axes.idempotencyVersion: One version increment and one audit; same old-version repeat returns409. Native duplicate tap inhibited; uncertain response requires fresh read, no automatic POST replay.
axes.concurrency: Request FOR UPDATE then current active member/capability share locks; deterministic lock-wait test revokes grant before request lock releases and gets403/no write. Poll and late UI responses bound to page epoch, token and session revision.
axes.databaseExternalEffects: One transaction updates response/version and inserts request event/audit without reply body in audit. No provider I/O, job execution, deletion, account closure or money action.
axes.limitsTimeoutPagination: Queue hard-bounded to100 ordered rows; UI states this limit. Full older-history pagination remains a technical gap. Shared route/actor rate limits, request/statement/lock budgets apply; foreground polling stops on hide/failure and is skipped during reply.
axes.positiveNegativeEvidence: 6 new real Fastify+PostgreSQL cases plus13 existing privacy-rights cases passed (19 total targeted);6 native Page behavior cases passed. Full exact-commit CI and native/device outcomes must be attached separately, not inferred from these tests.
